title: Atlanta Public Schools Policies
description: Learn about Atlanta Public Schools Schools policies and leaders.
body:
# Atlanta Public Schools Policies

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/ATLANTA.jpeg)

- District has an [Office of Equity and Social Justice](https://www.atlantapublicschools.us/about/departments/office-of-strategy/equity)
- The District participated in and promoted the Atlanta Pride Parade. They decorated a bus with pro-LGBT items.

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/Picture1.png)

- The school district has [a policy](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/55ddc178-384d-4b4a-89b9-a1c40404b132/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/GA-Atlanta-schools-teaches-divisive-controversial-concepts.png?language=en) that “supports and encourages an environment that fosters independent and critical thought, including the studying and teaching of issues which may be considered controversial or divisive. Atlanta Public Schools students and teachers have the following rights: To study and teach any controversial or divisive issue that has political, economic, or social significance in an age- and developmentally- appropriate manner.” and “To form and express opinions on controversial or divisive issues without fear of retaliation.”
